title: Easy Crockpot French Dip
cookTime: 5 hours on high or 8 hours on low
ingredients: 4 pound chuck roast, cut into 4 large chunks
4 cups beef broth (plus a splash for deglazing)
Hoagie or sandwich rolls for serving
instructions: Cut the chuck roast into 4 large chunks. Drizzle with a little oil and season well with steak seasoning.
Sear the chuck roast in a medium-to-high heat pan on all sides until deeply browned. Remove from pan.
In the same pan, melt 4 tablespoons of butter. Add 1 sliced yellow onion and cook for a few minutes.
Add a splash of beef broth to deglaze the pan. Cook for another few minutes.
Add 4 cups of beef broth and 1-2 tablespoons of Worcestershire sauce. Heat to a boil.
Make a cornstarch slurry: mix 2 tablespoons cornstarch with 2 tablespoons water, whisk well, then add to the pan and stir until slightly thickened.
Transfer the seared roast to your crockpot and pour the beef broth and onion mixture over it.
Cook on high for 5 hours or low for about 8 hours.
Remove any fat and shred the meat. Serve on sandwich rolls and dip in the juices. Enjoy!
notes: Serve as French Dip sandwiches with the au jus for dipping. Leftovers make great tacos or smothered burritos.
